assignment: Explicit root startup/refinement role request; native activation/registration remains root-owned.

mandatory_checks.startup_assessment: Identity owns set/individual verifier/operation state; Account identity and Product/session domains remain separate.
Reuse selected Identity/.NET crypto and Accounts/Database/Platform primitives. No generic credential framework, extra host, service or new dependency is justified.
Typed in-process consume/owner calls and SQL finality; post-commit outbox supports later notification owners. No external I/O under owner locks.
Distinct proof, individual claim, owner result and single transient first response; no reversible escrow to hide response uncertainty.
Explicit supported work/admission/lifetime profiles and owner retention/cleanup. No production defaults or unbounded native hash scan.
Existing ADR0006 and modular/BFF baseline cover this direction. A specific browser projection seam is engineering refinement, not a missing architectural authority.

required_before_implementation_or_accept: Supported owner profile and precise delivery/replacement inputs
Root-reviewed first-delivery BFF seam before module API edits
Actual tests and applicable UI consent/evidence
